limits: Complete copied-reference waveform identity/order and packet joins for short routes. One final Pause-interrupted WAV per segment is excluded, never prefix-qualified. Source-encoded silent packets have signal/aggregate timing checks between audible anchors, no individual acoustic identity. Guards exclude 250ms at Pause and next Play. No sustained, transcript, quality/voice, human listening, startup, memory or M3 acceptance.
